zh-CN.shortDesc: 搭建仓库内技能，并安装配套的迭代式编码智能体 GitHub Actions 工作流、提示词、记忆文件与参考模板；工作流运行所选编码智能体 CLI，需要运营者自有的 GitHub Actions 与智能体 API 密钥。

en-US.shortDesc: Build a repo-local skill and install a matching iterated coding-agent GitHub Actions workflow, prompt, memory file and reference templates; the workflow runs the chosen coding-agent CLI and needs the operator's own GitHub Actions and agent API secret.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 通过访谈与用户共同设计面向代码库的智能体控制回路（传感器、控制器、执行器与扰动），先做成可本地运行的组件，再接入定时编码智能体工作流；CI 运行需要运营者自有的 CI 与智能体 API 密钥。

en-US.shortDesc: Interview the user to design an agentic control loop (sensor, controller, actuator under disturbances) for their codebase, built as locally runnable components plus a scheduled coding-agent workflow; CI runs need the operator's own CI and agent API secret.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 用 <important if> 条件块改写 CLAUDE.md，提升智能体对指令的遵循度。

en-US.shortDesc: Improve a CLAUDE.md file using <important if> blocks to improve instruction adherence.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 以真实业务调用路径为准收窄 React 组件的属性类型，让 Storybook、测试与模拟数据适配真实契约。

en-US.shortDesc: Narrow React component prop types to match live code paths, making stories, tests and mocks adapt to the real contract.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 仅在用户按名称显式调用时运行：按研究问题、代码库调研、设计讨论 / PRD / 技术设计、实施大纲到实现的流程推进改动，在 .agents/artifacts 下保存可审阅文档；宿主支持时使用子 Agent 与网络搜索，不可用时按说明降级。

en-US.shortDesc: Runs only when the user invokes it by name: takes a change through research questions, codebase research, a design discussion, PRD or technical design, an implementation outline and implementation, saving reviewable documents under .agents/artifacts; uses host subagents and web search when available, with documented fallbacks.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 用简洁的图示、代码结构草图和聚焦的 HTML 页面，帮助用户直观理解当前话题。

en-US.shortDesc: Help the user understand the current topic visually with concise diagrams, code-shape sketches and focused HTML artifacts.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 仅在用户按名称显式调用时运行：为当前分支创建或更新拉取请求，撰写面向审阅者的简洁说明与结构化改动概览；需要 Git 与已授权的 GitHub CLI（gh），可能提交并推送分支。

en-US.shortDesc: Runs only when the user invokes it by name: creates or updates the current branch's pull request with a concise, reviewer-focused description and structural change outline; requires Git and an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh), and may commit and push the branch.
